items.title: 68003_Eddie Sauter oral history interview
items.q: Now meanwhile, we have this girl singer and Sperry in our band

ctx.x: He's in Reno now. We had Sperry Karas (phonetic spelling), who got drafted into the Seventh Army Symphony, was was instrumental in setting up that German episode. That was an experience, a unique one, but that didn't last very long though.
How did that come about? That was around '55 or something?
